To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the emerging technologies for learning are being used for workplace learning to provide a variety of learning facilities that support the management, development, and delivery of learning content, support the management, facilitation, and support of social interaction, support the management of learning and the delivery of learning content to mobile and ubiquitous devices, provide learning simulations that can be used in immersive virtual reality environments, and provide learning analytics to support the management of the learning process.

emerging technologies for workplace training are being used to provide a wide range of learning support and learning content management systems that support the creation, management, and delivery of learning content, social media and interaction that support the social interaction of learners, mobile and ubiquitous technologies that support the use of mobile devices for learning, computer simulations that support the creation of virtual learning experiences, educational data mining that supports the analysis of learner behavior and performance, computer assisted learning that supports the use of intelligent learning assistants, and cognitive processing technologies

the most promising emerging technologies are: social media and social networking, mobile devices and ubiquitous computing, computer simulations and virtual environments, and data mining and learning analysis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and evaluation of emerging technologies for workplace training and education.
understanding how people use technology in their daily lives.

the development of a learning management system (LMS) to provide a framework for the delivery of learning content, learning resources, learning support, and learning assessment to support learning in the workplace.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of emerging technologies for workplace training and development is a very important and useful way of improving the quality and quantity of workplace learning.
emerging technologies for workplace education and learning are not only a reality, but are here to stay, and will continue to be a major part of the future of workplace learning and education.
emerging technologies for workplace and work related learning are not only changing the nature of the learning environment but also the very essence of the learning process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the future is bright for workplace learning and that emerging technologies will play a significant role in the workplace learning of today and tomorrow.
emerging technologies are changing the way we work and learn in the workplace.
we have developed and evaluated an innovative and effective approach to workplace learning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
emerging technologies are changing the way we think about workplace learning, and they are providing new ways of thinking about how we can improve workplace learning.
there are a number of emerging technologies that are being used to support workplace and informal workplace learning, which are not necessarily being used to support formal workplace learning.

emerging technologies for workplace training and learning are not only changing the ways in which workplace training and learning is conducted but are also changing the nature of workplace training and learning itself.
